paragraphs: Shape the final look of your work with the toolkit trusted by motion designers, VFX artists, and editors for over 20 years. Red Giant brings particles, lens flares, color grading, keying, and motion design tools directly into After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and other hosts you already work in. Build looks that feel uniquely yours and hit deadlines while you're at it.
To use the application you will have to register for a MyMaxon account and accept our EULA.

Design type and motion that carry a brand's personality. Trapcode Particular, Form, and the motion graphics tools give you systematic control over complex animation without leaving After Effects. Best for: Brand animation, broadcast design, title sequences, social content.

Iterate looks in real time and push polished work out the door. Red Giant tools are built for the final, fastest stretch of production.
Natively supported in After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Avid Media Composer, Autograph, and Cinema 4D. No new app to learn, no workflow to rebuild.
These tools have a strong reputation for shipping broadcast graphics, commercials, music videos, and film titles for over two decades. They deliver when it counts.
Red Giant completes the Maxon ecosystem: animate in Cinema 4D, render in Redshift, then grade, composite, and stylize the result without friction.
Maxon Studio's template library gets a professional result fast, and everything it makes stays editable underneath.
Build particle systems, organic forms, and 3D effects directly in After Effects. Trapcode Particular and Form give you physics, flocking, and fluid behaviors.
Grade with Magic Bullet Looks' real-time, on-footage color tools: film emulation, look development, and finishing that work inside your editing timeline.

Pull clean keys from difficult greenscreens, track and clean up shots, create fully 3D muzzle flashes with Bang, and add photoreal lens flares with Real Lens Flares. Compositing tools that make elements sit naturally in the frame.
Animate shapes, lines, and typography: dynamic titles, type reveals, scrolling code, progress bars, and layer cloning for systematic motion design.
Glitches, retro looks, glows, blurs, distortions, and transitions that cut together cleanly that transform footage in a few clicks. Plus, they remain editable after.

Universe is a vast library of video post-production plugins included in your Red Giant subscription. Transform and enhance your edits with customizable transitions, effects, stylization, and finishing tools.
A library of looped backgrounds, titles, and motion graphics templates with an interface for browsing, adapting, and customizing them to fit your project.

Red Giant tools are natively supported in the industry's standard editing, compositing, and motion design applications: After Effects (the deepest integration), Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Apple Motion, Final Cut Pro, Avid Media Composer, Autograph, and Cinema 4D. One subscription covers them all.

Real Lens Flares gains an interactive zoom that lets flares evolve with your focal length, plus support for aspherical lenses and 44 new presets for matching real-world glass. Trapcode Particular now loads faster, with a preference for how many particle systems it starts with, so simple setups open quickly and complex projects keep their headroom.

Red Giant is a professional toolkit for motion graphics, visual effects, and video post-production from Maxon. Red Giant runs as plugins inside applications like After Effects, Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve, adding particles, color grading, keying, lens flares, text animation, and finishing tools to the software you already use.
What is Red Giant used for?

Motion designers, VFX artists, and editors use Red Giant for the finishing work that shapes how a piece finally looks and feels. This includes broadcast graphics, title sequences, brand animation, color grading, greenscreen keying, shot cleanup, and stylized effects. Red Giant’s compositing tools help creators iterate on ideas quickly and help each element sit naturally in the shot.
What software does Red Giant support?

Red Giant tools run in Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Apple Motion, Final Cut Pro, Avid Media Composer, Autograph, and Cinema 4D. Check the requirements page for the per-tool compatibility matrix.
What tools are included with Red Giant?

A Red Giant subscription includes the full toolkit: particle and 3D effects like Trapcode Particular and Form, Magic Bullet Looks color grading, keying and VFX tools including Real Lens Flares, motion graphics and text animation tools, transitions, and the Maxon Studio template library, plus a growing set of Capsules assets.
Is Red Giant good for beginners?
Yes. The tools produce professional results from sensible defaults, and every preset stays fully editable as your skills grow. Cineversity training is included with your subscription.
How is Red Giant different from stock templates?
Templates give you someone else's finished look; Red Giant gives you the tools that made it. Start from a preset if you like, then push every parameter until the result is unmistakably yours.
Does Red Giant work with Cinema 4D and Redshift?
Yes. Red Giant is the finishing layer of the Maxon ecosystem: animate in Cinema 4D, render in Redshift, then grade, composite, and stylize the output with Red Giant tools.
